name: Camping Wohnmobilstellplatz Plankenhof
beschreibung: The Plankenhof camping and motorhome site is located in the municipality of Pill in the Tiroler Unterinntal. The surroundings are characterized by mountains and nature. Nearby are hiking trails and ski areas such as Kellerjoch. The site has pitches for motorhomes with electricity connection and water supply. The sanitary facilities are simple and functional. There is a quiet and family-friendly atmosphere. Guests use the site as a starting point for activities in the region.
